package usecase

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"testing"

	"github.com/bemulima/ms-go-practice-runtime/internal/domain"
)

func TestPlannerMaterialsForStepReadsEveryFrozenTargetInOrder(t *testing.T) {
	route := json.RawMessage(`[{"step_id":"step-a","ready":false,"requirements":[{"id":"step-a.target-001","material":{"key":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","generation_key":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","target":{"type":"concept","key":"one","version":"v1"}}},{"id":"step-a.target-002","material":{"key":"bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb","generation_key":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000002","target":{"type":"concept","key":"two","version":"v2"}}}]},{"step_id":"step-b","requirements":[]}]`)
	materials, err := plannerMaterialsForStep(route, "step-a")
	if err != nil {
		t.Fatalf("planner material projection failed: %v", err)
	}
	if len(materials) != 2 || materials[0].Key != "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" ||
		materials[1].Key != "bbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbbb" {
		t.Fatalf("materials were not preserved in frozen requirement order: %+v", materials)
	}
}

func TestPlannerMaterialsForStepFailsClosedOnMissingOrMalformedMaterial(t *testing.T) {
	cases := []struct {
		name    string
		route   json.RawMessage
		wantErr error
	}{
		{name: "missing step", route: json.RawMessage(`[{"step_id":"step-b","requirements":[]}]`), wantErr: domain.ErrNotFound},
		{name: "empty steps", route: json.RawMessage(`[]`), wantErr: domain.ErrNotFound},
		{name: "wrapped route object", route: json.RawMessage(`{"steps":[{"step_id":"step-a","requirements":[]}]}`), wantErr: domain.ErrDependency},
		{name: "null steps", route: json.RawMessage(`null`), wantErr: domain.ErrDependency},
		{name: "malformed array", route: json.RawMessage(`[{`), wantErr: domain.ErrDependency},
		{name: "bad key", route: json.RawMessage(`[{"step_id":"step-a","requirements":[{"id":"r1","material":{"key":"bad","generation_key":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","target":{"type":"concept","key":"one","version":"v1"}}}]}]`), wantErr: domain.ErrDependency},
		{name: "bad generation", route: json.RawMessage(`[{"step_id":"step-a","requirements":[{"id":"r1","material":{"key":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","generation_key":"not-a-uuid","target":{"type":"concept","key":"one","version":"v1"}}}]}]`), wantErr: domain.ErrDependency},
		{name: "missing target version", route: json.RawMessage(`[{"step_id":"step-a","requirements":[{"id":"r1","material":{"key":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","generation_key":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","target":{"type":"concept","key":"one"}}}]}]`), wantErr: domain.ErrDependency},
	}
	for _, test := range cases {
		t.Run(test.name, func(t *testing.T) {
			if _, err := plannerMaterialsForStep(test.route, "step-a"); !errors.Is(err, test.wantErr) {
				t.Fatalf("frozen material error = %v, want %v", err, test.wantErr)
			}
		})
	}
}

// ResolveRoute's production DTO stores the wire steps field as this array.
// A whole-route object here would conceal a producer/consumer incompatibility.
func TestPlannerMaterialsForStepConsumesActualPlannerStepsArray(t *testing.T) {
	steps := json.RawMessage(`[{"step_id":"step-a","ready":false,"requirements":[{"id":"step-a.target-001","material":{"key":"aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa","generation_key":"00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001","target":{"type":"concept","key":"one","version":"v1"}}}]}]`)
	materials, err := plannerMaterialsForStep(steps, "step-a")
	if err != nil || len(materials) != 1 || materials[0].Key != "aaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaaa" || materials[0].GenerationKey != "00000000-0000-4000-8000-000000000001" {
		t.Fatalf("actual frozen Planner steps array must retain material identity: materials=%+v err=%v", materials, err)
	}
}
